rationale: C16 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child. Both are short presidential greetings addressed to a visiting foreign president, open with a welcome to Washington, refer to the visit and relations between the two countries, and close by hoping the visitor's stay will be pleasant. The child's wording closely adapts C16's distinctive welcome-and-pleasant-visit structure, while adding an explanation that illness prevents an in-person greeting. C05 and C11 share diplomatic language about friendship between peoples, but neither provides the same visit-welcome framework.

shared_material.child_excerpt: let me assure you of a most sincere welcome on behalf of the people of the United States
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Permit me again to extend to you a most cordial welcome
shared_material.explanation: Closely parallel formal welcome language directed to an arriving foreign president.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I hope that your sojourn in this country will be most enjoyable
shared_material.parent_excerpt: to express the hope that this visit in the United States will be both pleasant and profitable
shared_material.explanation: Both couple the welcome with an explicit hope that the visiting president's stay in the United States will be pleasant.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There will be many manifestations, I am sure, of the warm friendship that exists between our peoples.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: one of the most historic events in Philippine-American relations and a vital milestone in our mutual quest for peace and security
shared_material.explanation: Both place the visit within the friendly bilateral relationship, although the child uses more general language.
